records.source: Wow, this snowman needs a makeover. Who made this?$s
records.translation: Wow, kailangan ng bagong ayos ang taong-niyebeng ito. Sino ang gumawa nito?$s

records.source: $y 'Hmm... What kind of snowman should we make?_A classic one. Carrot nose, top-hat, scarf._I guess maybe it's best to stick with the classics, huh?$h_Something funky. Icicle antennas, pine cone eyes._Okay! That sounds like fun.$h_Snowmen are boring. Think outside of the box!_Um, okay... I think I might stick with something more conventional.'
records.translation: $y 'Hmm... Anong uri ng taong-niyebe ang gagawin natin?_Karaniwan. Ilong na karot, sombrerong silindro, at bandana._Mukhang pinakamabuti ngang manatili sa nakasanayan, hindi ba?$h_Isang kakaiba. Mga antenang yelong tulis at matang bunga ng pino._Sige! Mukhang masaya iyon.$h_Nakakabagot ang mga taong-niyebe. Mag-isip nang kakaiba!_Um, sige... Sa tingin ko, mas gusto ko ang mas nakasanayan.'

records.source: I plan on winning the ice fishing competition!#$e#Willy is gonna be pretty hard to beat, though... He does this kinda stuff day and night.$s
records.translation: Balak kong manalo sa paligsahan sa pangingisda sa yelo!#$e#Pero mahirap talunin si Willy... Araw-gabi niyang ginagawa ang ganitong bagay.$s

records.source: I guess Winter isn't all bad... playing in the snow can be fun!
records.translation: Mukhang hindi naman ganap na masama ang taglamig... masayang maglaro sa niyebe!

records.source: The forest looks beautiful in the winter, doesn't it?
records.translation: Napakaganda ng gubat sa taglamig, hindi ba?

records.source: I like winter. It's peaceful.
records.translation: Gusto ko ang taglamig. Payapa ito.

records.source: Hey, @. Are you gonna enter the ice fishing competition?#$e#Oh, not me. I don't know how to fish.
records.translation: Hoy, @. Sasali ka ba sa paligsahan sa pangingisda sa yelo?#$e#Oh, ako, hindi. Hindi ako marunong mangisda.

records.source: Oh, ice. A beautiful material to sculpt in, but so impermanent.#$e#But I guess that might make the art even better.
records.translation: Oh, yelo. Napakagandang materyal na lililukin, pero hindi ito nagtatagal.#$e#Pero baka lalo nitong pinahuhusay ang sining.

records.source: I feel bad for all the poor, cold animals out there.$s
records.translation: Naaawa ako sa lahat ng kawawa at nilalamig na hayop sa labas.$s

records.source: I'm entering the ice fishing competition today. Why not?#$e#It's rare that Willy ever loses, though.
records.translation: Sasali ako sa paligsahan sa pangingisda sa yelo ngayon. Bakit hindi?#$e#Pero bihirang matalo si Willy.

records.source: Sorry there's no food.#$e#Just wait until the Feast of the Winter Star. You'll be stuffed for days.
records.translation: Pasensiya na at walang pagkain.#$e#Hintayin mo lang ang Piging ng Bituin ng Taglamig. Ilang araw kang mabubusog.

records.source: Sneaking off to visit my weird tower? You're odd for a mundane.
records.translation: Palihim kang pumunta para dalawin ang kakaiba kong tore? Kakaiba ka para sa isang ordinaryong tao.

records.source: Extreme temperatures can put your body under a lot of stress, so make sure to bundle up!#$e#Oh, and enjoy the festival!$h
records.translation: Maaaring labis na pahirapan ng matinding temperatura ang katawan mo, kaya tiyaking magsuot ng makapal na damit!#$e#Oh, at magsaya ka sa pista!$h

records.source: I heard it's raining back home. Is that why you came here?$h#$e#I kind of miss the rain, actually...$s
records.translation: Narinig kong umuulan sa inyo. Iyon ba ang dahilan kung bakit ka pumunta rito?$h#$e#Sa totoo lang, medyo hinahanap-hanap ko rin ang ulan...$s

records.source: I wanna give him a carrot nose!$h
records.translation: Gusto kong bigyan siya ng ilong na karot!$h

records.source: I saw a big fish down there!
records.translation: May nakita akong malaking isda roon sa ilalim!

records.source: Hey, good afternoon.
records.translation: Hoy, magandang hapon.

records.source: You could make an igloo twice as warm if you stuffed feathers in the walls!
records.translation: Magagawa mong doblehin ang init ng isang igloo kung pupunuin mo ng mga balahibo ang mga dingding!

records.source: Imagine if we lived in an igloo together!$h#$e#It would be fun, but I'm happy living anywhere with you.$l
records.translation: Isipin mo kung magkasama tayong nakatira sa isang igloo!$h#$e#Magiging masaya, pero masaya akong tumira kahit saan kasama ka.$l

records.source: When we get home, let's make a fire and have some hot cocoa.$0#$e#...with marshmallows?$h
records.translation: Pag-uwi natin, magsindi tayo ng apoy at uminom ng mainit na tsokolate.$0#$e#...na may mga marshmallow?$h

records.source: Come here, let me fix your hair... I'm going to take an action shot of you during the contest!
records.translation: Halika, ayusin ko ang buhok mo... Kukuhanan kita ng larawan habang kumikilos sa paligsahan!

records.source: Hey, you really need to win the contest today.$0#$e#Uh... well, I guess I made a little bet with Marlon...$1
records.translation: Hoy, kailangan mo talagang manalo sa paligsahan ngayon.$0#$e#Uh... kasi, may maliit akong pustahan kay Marlon...$1

records.source: You should teach me how to use a fishing rod sometime. I think I'd be good at it.
records.translation: Turuan mo ako minsan kung paano gumamit ng pamingwit. Sa tingin ko, magiging mahusay ako roon.
